map.按体重、每组次数、组数与每周天数估算康复动作负荷，并给出每周 +10% 的渐进参: Estimate rehab exercise load from body weight, reps, sets and weekly frequency, with a 10% weekly progression guide and a pain-score safety check.
map.单次负荷(kg·次) = 体重 × 每组次数 × 组数；周负荷 = 单次负荷 ×: Session load (kg·reps) = body weight × reps × sets; weekly load = session load × days per week; next-week reference = weekly load × 1.1 (+10%); set duration ≈ reps × 3 s. Pain score 0-10: above 3, reduce or pause and consult a rehab clinician.
map.负荷按“体重×次数×组数”做算术估算，周负荷为单次负荷乘以每周天数；渐进参考只加: Load is an arithmetic estimate of body weight × reps × sets; weekly load multiplies the session load by days per week; progression adds only 10% and does not replace a rehab prescription. The pain score is a safety gate: above 3/10 or worse next day, reduce the load first.
map.💡 单次负荷 = 体重 × 每组次数 × 组数；周负荷 = 单次 × 每周天数；: 💡 Session load = body weight × reps × sets; weekly load = session × days per week; next week +10%. If pain is >3/10 or worse next day, reduce the load and consult a rehab clinician.
